texts.zh:
星海共同体中夹杂着一阵不和谐的杂音，不是所有人都很友好，肯定地说这其中必有与[Root.GetAdj]利益不一致的人。不妙的是，使者[event_envoy.GetName]似乎正在听取某种错误的声音。在参加由[Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]主办的几场会议中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]的眉毛止不住地上翘。现在一切都水落石出了，一笔可以追溯到某个组织的巨款被查明汇入了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]的账户。

[event_envoy.GetName]的同事们要求将[event_envoy.GetSheHe]召回并发起不信任议案。然而，某些更为狡诈的顾问建议我们和[event_envoy.GetHerHim]达成一笔交易，维持其现有职位以换取获得情报的机会。
texts.en:
A cacophony of voices may be heard in the Galactic Community - not all of them friendly, and certainly not all of them aligning with [Root.GetAdj] interests. Unfortunately, it seems that emissary [event_envoy.GetName] has been listening to the wrong voices. Eyebrows were raised when [event_envoy.GetSheHe] attended several conferences hosted by the [Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]. Now it has emerged that a large sum of credits traceable to that organization were transferred to [event_envoy.GetHerHim].

[event_envoy.GetName]'s colleagues demand that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] be recalled, citing trust issues. However, some of our more devious advisors suggest that we could strike a deal to keep [event_envoy.GetHerHim] in place in return for a share of the pot.

summary.text:
# 说客 / Lobbyists

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/envoy_events.txt:2365-2423`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

Galactic Community 特使的随机事件：五年脉冲（action.2211）的负面列表 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list，权重见分支栏（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592）；on_action 会先检查事件触发条件、不满足的从列表中剔除，所以只要有一个能触发就必有一个触发。通常共用5400天的 recent_envoy_event 冷却。 本事件：非集群，特使任职于共同体，无 recent_envoy_event；权重20/180。

A random Galactic Community envoy event: the negative list of the five-year pulse (action.2211), on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list, weights in the branches (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592); on_actions check each event's trigger first and drop the failing ones, so as long as any can fire one always does. Most share a 5400-day recent_envoy_event cooldown. This event: Non-gestalt, an envoy assigned to the Community, no recent_envoy_event; weight 20 of 180.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

特使被游说者收买。选项一：每月获得能量加成（tier1），但10年内受 beholden_to_special_interests 修正拖累；选项二：召回重训，特使被撤职并获得“腐败”特质。

The envoy is courted by lobbyists. Option one: a monthly energy bonus (tier 1) but ten years of the beholden_to_special_interests modifier; option two: recall for retraining, the envoy is unassigned and gains the Corrupt trait.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

二选一。

One of two.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了脚本触发和选项；与同一列表中的其他事件互相独立。

Trigger and options were checked against the script; independent of the other events in the same list.
